agentDecisions.rationale: HARD_DECLINE: Fraud flag or blocked instrument. Retrying cannot succeed and repeated attempts risk the merchant’s authorisation rates. Stop, and route to risk review if the amount warrants a human.

TRANSIENT_INFRA.reasoning: Infrastructure failure, not a customer problem. Retry silently once the outage has had time to clear; contacting the customer would only add doubt.

TRANSIENT_FUNDS.reasoning: Needs a balance top-up or a daily limit reset. Retrying inside the hour wastes an attempt; a day later is when it lands.

CUSTOMER_ACTION_REQUIRED.reasoning: The instrument itself is dead. No retry can succeed until the customer replaces it, so spend nothing on attempts and everything on a clear nudge.

ABANDONMENT.reasoning: Purchase intent decays by the hour. Re-engage while they are still in the moment; a reminder tomorrow is a reminder they already moved on.

AUTH_FAILURE.reasoning: A corrected attempt works, but not in the same second. Give them a beat, then prompt if it is still unpaid.

HARD_DECLINE.reasoning: The issuer refused with prejudice — a fraud flag, a blocked instrument, or a decline with no stated cause. Retrying cannot succeed and repeated attempts risk the merchant’s authorisation rates. Stop, and route to risk review if the amount warrants a human.

payment_failure.label: Payment failure
payment_failure.reasoning: The customer authorised this charge, so re-attempting it is legitimate.

checkout_abandonment.label: Checkout drop-off
checkout_abandonment.reasoning: Nothing was authorised, so there is no charge to retry. Recovery means bringing the customer back, quickly, before the intent goes.

subscription_mandate.label: Subscription / mandate
subscription_mandate.reasoning: A standing mandate authorises repeated attempts, and an ongoing subscriber is worth patience rather than pressure.

receivable.label: B2B receivable
receivable.reasoning: An invoice, not a charge. Nothing can be retried; recovery is a chase, and a commitment to pay is worth tracking and following up.

scenarios.name: Baseline week
scenarios.description: An ordinary trading week. UPI-heavy, with insufficient funds and bank downtime as the leading failure reasons.

strategies.name: Do nothing
strategies.description: Write off every failed payment immediately. The floor: zero recovered, zero spent.

strategies.name: Naive retry
strategies.description: Retry three times in quick succession, ignoring the failure reason. The obvious implementation.

strategies.name: Fixed dunning
strategies.description: Retry on a fixed +1h / +24h / +72h ladder regardless of failure reason, then send a single email.

strategies.name: Reason-aware agent
strategies.description: Classifies each failure by Razorpay reason code and runs a per-class playbook: fast on abandonment, patient on funds, zero retries on hopeless classes, and value-weighted escalation.

scenarios.name: Bank outage
scenarios.description: A major partner bank goes down for part of the day. Most failures are transient infrastructure and highly recoverable, but only if you wait for the outage to clear rather than hammering it.

strategies.name: Do nothing
strategies.description: Write off every failed payment immediately. The floor: zero recovered, zero spent.

strategies.name: Naive retry
strategies.description: Retry three times in quick succession, ignoring the failure reason. The obvious implementation.

strategies.name: Fixed dunning
strategies.description: Retry on a fixed +1h / +24h / +72h ladder regardless of failure reason, then send a single email.

strategies.name: Reason-aware agent
strategies.description: Classifies each failure by Razorpay reason code and runs a per-class playbook: fast on abandonment, patient on funds, zero retries on hopeless classes, and value-weighted escalation.

scenarios.name: Month-end squeeze
scenarios.description: The days before payday. Insufficient funds and exhausted daily limits dominate. The money is recoverable, but only on a multi-day horizon.

strategies.name: Do nothing
strategies.description: Write off every failed payment immediately. The floor: zero recovered, zero spent.

strategies.name: Naive retry
strategies.description: Retry three times in quick succession, ignoring the failure reason. The obvious implementation.

strategies.name: Fixed dunning
strategies.description: Retry on a fixed +1h / +24h / +72h ladder regardless of failure reason, then send a single email.

strategies.name: Reason-aware agent
strategies.description: Classifies each failure by Razorpay reason code and runs a per-class playbook: fast on abandonment, patient on funds, zero retries on hopeless classes, and value-weighted escalation.

scenarios.name: Risk spike
scenarios.description: A wave of fraud-flagged and blocked-instrument declines. Nearly nothing here is recoverable. The right answer is to stop early, and a naive retry loop is actively harmful.

strategies.name: Do nothing
strategies.description: Write off every failed payment immediately. The floor: zero recovered, zero spent.

strategies.name: Naive retry
strategies.description: Retry three times in quick succession, ignoring the failure reason. The obvious implementation.

strategies.name: Fixed dunning
strategies.description: Retry on a fixed +1h / +24h / +72h ladder regardless of failure reason, then send a single email.

strategies.name: Reason-aware agent
strategies.description: Classifies each failure by Razorpay reason code and runs a per-class playbook: fast on abandonment, patient on funds, zero retries on hopeless classes, and value-weighted escalation.

scenarios.name: Stale instruments
scenarios.description: Expired cards, deregistered VPAs and disabled online payments. No retry can ever succeed here. Every rupee recovered has to come through a customer nudge.

strategies.name: Do nothing
strategies.description: Write off every failed payment immediately. The floor: zero recovered, zero spent.

strategies.name: Naive retry
strategies.description: Retry three times in quick succession, ignoring the failure reason. The obvious implementation.

strategies.name: Fixed dunning
strategies.description: Retry on a fixed +1h / +24h / +72h ladder regardless of failure reason, then send a single email.

strategies.name: Reason-aware agent
strategies.description: Classifies each failure by Razorpay reason code and runs a per-class playbook: fast on abandonment, patient on funds, zero retries on hopeless classes, and value-weighted escalation.
